plates.title: The Annunciation
plates.alt: The angel Gabriel, wings raised, kneels before Mary at her prayer desk beneath a great stone arch, as the dove of the Holy Ghost descends on her in a burst of light

plates.title: The Visitation
plates.alt: Mary and her cousin Elizabeth embrace outdoors before a house, while an old man watches from the doorway and three women look on beneath tall trees and distant mountains

plates.title: The Nativity
plates.alt: Mary kneels in adoration of the newborn Child lying in a basket amid angels in a ruined, half-roofed stable, while Joseph approaches and shepherds look in; a star and flying angels fill the sky

plates.title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
plates.alt: In a vast columned temple, Mary kneels at the altar holding out an offering while the aged Simeon receives the Child among onlookers

plates.title: Christ among the Doctors
plates.alt: The boy Jesus sits teaching the learned doctors in a vaulted temple hall while Mary and Joseph enter at the left

plates.title: The Agony in the Garden
plates.alt: Christ kneels in prayer on a rocky hillside as an angel offers the chalice, while Peter, James and John sleep below and soldiers approach in the distance

plates.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
plates.alt: Christ stands bound to a column in a vaulted hall while tormentors strike him with rods and onlookers crowd around

plates.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
plates.alt: Christ sits bound beneath arches as a kneeling man mockingly offers him a reed and other men press the crown of thorns on his head with sticks

plates.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
plates.alt: Christ bends beneath the weight of the cross as soldiers drive him on and holy women grieve at the left near a city gate

plates.title: The Crucifixion
plates.alt: Christ hangs on the cross under the INRI title; Mary and the holy women grieve with Saint John on the left, soldiers with spears stand on the right, and Mary Magdalene kneels at the foot of the cross beside a skull

plates.title: The Resurrection
plates.alt: The risen Christ, holding a banner, rises in a blaze of light above the sealed tomb, with cherubs in the clouds and the soldiers asleep or startled in armour around him

plates.title: The Ascension
plates.alt: The apostles and Mary kneel and gaze upward as only the feet of the ascending Christ remain visible in the clouds above

plates.title: Pentecost
plates.alt: The Holy Spirit as a dove radiates light over Mary and the apostles, who sit and stand with small flames on their heads

plates.title: The Death of the Virgin
plates.alt: Mary lies propped on pillows in a canopied bed, holding a candle, as the apostles gather around her in prayer, with censer, book and processional cross

plates.title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
plates.alt: On the clouds above, the Father and the Son crown Mary as the dove of the Holy Ghost hovers over her; below, the Apostles gather in wonder around her empty tomb

plates.title: The Baptism of Jesus
plates.alt: Jesus stands waist-deep in the Jordan while John the Baptist, clothed in skins, raises his hand above him; a dove descends in a shaft of light from the clouds and onlookers kneel on the bank

plates.title: The Marriage at Cana
plates.alt: Under a draped canopy at a long banquet table Christ sits with the wedding guests while servants in the foreground fill great stone water jars

plates.title: The Sermon on the Mount
plates.alt: Christ sits among olive trees with one hand raised, teaching a large crowd of men, women and children gathered around him on the hillside

plates.title: The Transfiguration
plates.series: La Grande Bible de Tours (as reproduced in The Bible Panorama, 1891)
plates.alt: Christ radiant in the clouds between Moses with the tablets of the Law and Elijah, while three apostles lie fallen on the mountainside below
plates.licence: PD-old-100 (Flickr Commons: no known copyright restrictions)

plates.title: The Last Supper
plates.series: La Grande Bible de Tours (as reproduced in The Bible Panorama, 1891)
plates.alt: Christ with a halo of light at the centre of a long table with a chalice and bread before him, the twelve apostles gathered about him in a columned room
plates.licence: PD-old-100 (Flickr Commons: no known copyright restrictions)

plates.title: The Presentation in the Temple (Simeon's prophecy)
plates.alt: In a pillared temple hall, Mary kneels at the altar table offering the Child to the aged Simeon, while Joseph and a crowd of onlookers gather round

plates.title: The Flight into Egypt
plates.alt: Mary, the Child in her arms, rides a donkey through a palm forest as Joseph strides ahead leading it, with a host of angels in the clouds above

plates.title: Christ among the Doctors
plates.alt: Under a great arch, the boy Jesus sits among the doctors of the Temple, who consult their books, while Mary and Joseph enter anxiously at the left

plates.title: The Bearing of the Cross
plates.alt: Christ, crowned with thorns, falls beneath the weight of the cross among soldiers and onlookers, while Mary and the holy women grieve at the lower left

plates.title: The Crucifixion
plates.alt: Christ hangs on the cross under the INRI title; Mary and the holy women grieve with Saint John on the left, soldiers with spears stand on the right, and Mary Magdalene kneels at the foot of the cross beside a skull

plates.title: The Lamentation
plates.alt: Beneath the cross, the dead body of Christ, just taken down, is held up by his disciples while Mary clasps her hands in grief, a woman cries out with raised arms, and Mary Magdalene bends to his feet; the crown of thorns lies on the ground

plates.title: The Entombment
plates.alt: Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus lay the body of Christ in the stone tomb, while Mary, Saint John and the holy women mourn behind, one with a jar of ointment; the crown of thorns lies in the grass

plates.title: The Holy Family with the Dragonfly
plates.alt: Mary, her long hair loose, sits in a landscape holding the Christ Child to her cheek while Joseph sleeps beside her; the Father and the dove shine from the clouds above and a river town lies behind

plates.title: The Holy Family in Egypt
plates.alt: Mary sits spinning and sewing beside the cradle with angels attending her, while Joseph works with an axe at a timber trough and child angels gather wood chips; God the Father and the dove look down from the clouds

plates.title: The Madonna on the Crescent
plates.alt: Title page of a printed book: under a Latin heading, Mary, crowned with stars and surrounded by rays of light, sits on a crescent moon nursing the Christ Child, above a short Latin poem

plates.title: The Madonna on the Crescent (detail)
plates.alt: Mary, crowned with stars and surrounded by rays of light, sits on a crescent moon nursing the Christ Child

plates.title: The Virgin and Child with the Monkey
plates.alt: Mary, a halo about her head, sits by a river holding the Christ Child, who has a small bird on his hand; a chained monkey crouches at her feet and a half-timbered house stands behind
